# Hide rule fixes of fix/hide99. Compare the branch with main by running it twice (the same version both times).
# Run: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=<branch or commit> -f script=.github/checks/hide-fixes.txt
#
# 1 (hide-cave-*): Hide in caves on, in a sealed stone room 30 blocks up (no sky light inside), Record card on.
#   -dry: standing on the floor, head in the air: no lyrics, no top bar, no Record card (both).
#   -pool: the room filled with water over your head (blue underwater view): still nothing
#   (main: the lyrics, the top bar and the Record card are back).
#   -open: the roof taken off, head still under water: everything back (both), as open sky ends it.
# 2 (hide-pause-*): Hide in menus on, back on the ground at night.
#   -nomenu: the pause of F3 + Esc ("Game Paused" at the top, no buttons): the lyrics show in the sky.
#   -menu: the pause menu with its buttons: no lyrics (both).
#   main's test hook doesn't know "pause nomenu" and opens the full pause menu there, so on main both pictures show
#   the menu; the unit test HideInMenusTest is the proof that main hid the lyrics for F3 + Esc.

cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
set recordCard true
set cardLyrics true
set hideInCaves true
look 0 -20
sleep 6

# 1: a dark room, then a pool in it, then open sky over the pool
cmd execute as @p at @p run fill ~-3 ~29 ~-3 ~3 ~34 ~3 minecraft:stone hollow
cmd execute as @p at @p run tp @s ~ ~30 ~
sleep 3
seek 21
sleep 2
shot hide-cave-dry
cmd execute as @p at @p run fill ~-2 ~ ~-2 ~2 ~2 ~2 minecraft:water
sleep 3
seek 21
sleep 2
shot hide-cave-pool
cmd execute as @p at @p run fill ~-2 ~4 ~-2 ~2 ~4 ~2 minecraft:air
sleep 3
seek 21
sleep 2
shot hide-cave-open

# 2: back down, F3 + Esc's pause and the pause menu
cmd execute as @p at @p run tp @s ~ ~-30 ~
set hideInCaves false
set hideInMenus true
look 0 -20
sleep 3
seek 21
sleep 1
pause nomenu
sleep 2
shot hide-pause-nomenu
close
sleep 1
pause
sleep 2
shot hide-pause-menu
close
set hideInMenus false
